categories.evidence: Rate limiting, token revocation, CORS allowlist, magic-byte upload validation, path-traversal defense, thread-safety fixes, prompt-injection tests implemented and unit-tested. No dependency/static-analysis scan has run (tools not installed in this dev environment).
PBKDF2 (200k iterations), 8-char minimum, login/register rate-limit+lockout, per-token revocation - all unit-tested.

Per-user data isolation is tenant-isolation-tested. Role-based access (admin vs user) implemented and unit-tested at the function level; the 3 admin HTTP endpoints have not been exercised through a live request.
Pipeline structurally verified via unit tests and code reading. No live Recall@K/MRR/NDCG numbers exist yet - evaluation/ framework is built and self-test-verified but not run against a real corpus.

Citation metadata/structure unchanged and correct. Citation quality metrics implemented and tested at the arithmetic level, never run against real judged data. Confidence-labeling anti-pattern (brief section 19) fixed this pass.
No live Ollama/GPU in this development environment. evaluation/benchmark_ollama.py and evaluation/runner/run_eval.py are built and will produce real numbers on real hardware.

No load test performed. Concurrency-safety bugs (model-loader race, session-write lost-update) were found and fixed with passing tests this pass; throughput/scalability is a separate, unmeasured claim.
Circuit breaker, classified failover, exponential backoff+jitter, health/readiness endpoints implemented and tested. No sustained-load or crash-recovery test run.
Local + Docker Compose documented and internally consistent; not actually built/run (no Docker daemon in this environment). Kubernetes manifests written, never applied to a cluster.
Full docs/ set present: architecture, security, threat-model, evaluation, metrics, deployment, performance, api, troubleshooting, operations, development, data-retention, release-checklist.

final_security_statement: No known critical or high-severity vulnerability was identified in the code paths touched by this engagement, by the automated unit tests and manual review performed, as of this writing. This is not a claim of zero vulnerabilities: no dependency scanner, static analyzer, or penetration test has actually run.
recommendation_detail: Ready with conditions for continued local/desktop use, with every security and performance fix from this engagement in place and tested at the unit level. Not ready for public-internet production deployment until real-hardware verification (see REMAINING_WORK.md Bucket A) is complete.
